# MY PG - PG Management Software
> India's #1 PG (Paying Guest) management platform | https://manageyourpg.com

## Core
MY PG is a comprehensive PG management software for Indian PG owners, landlords, and property managers. It automates rent collection, tenant management, room occupancy tracking, expense reporting, and daily operations. Available as an Android app and web dashboard with multi-language support.

- **Platform**: Android app + Web dashboard
- **Users**: 5000+ PG owners, 50,000+ tenants managed  
- **Coverage**: 25+ cities across India
- **Rating**: 4.8/5 stars
- **Pricing**: 7-day free trial (no credit card), then ₹499/month or ₹3999/year (save 33%)
- **Languages**: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi
- **Website**: https://manageyourpg.com

### Key Features
- Automated rent collection with WhatsApp reminders & UPI/GPay/PhonePe/Paytm integration
- Tenant management with digital KYC storage and police verification
- Room and bed management with real-time occupancy tracking
- Expense tracking, categorization, and reporting
- Multi-property management from a single dashboard
- Digital rent receipts generation
- CCTV camera integration and live surveillance
- Food and mess management with meal plan tracking
- Cleaning and maintenance scheduling
- Short stay (daily/weekly) and long stay (monthly/yearly) rental management
- Self check-in requests and tenant communication

### Current Job Openings
